description: Asks, on a writable copy, which CREATE INDEX and DROP INDEX spellings Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) accepts over Dm, each followed by DBEngine.Errors: single and compound keys with ASC and DESC, UNIQUE, WITH PRIMARY twice, DISALLOW NULL and IGNORE NULL together, no index name, an unknown column and table, a Memo, Yes/No and Double key, the same index name on two tables and the name of a table, CLUSTERED, HASH, FULLTEXT and USING forms, a repeated column, DROP INDEX with and without ON and on an unknown table. At the end the indexes of Dm (Name, Primary, Unique, IgnoreNulls, Required, Clustered) are read. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
